analysis.summary: Deep ocean abyss footage featuring bioluminescent jellyfish glowing in the darkness. Multiple jellyfish in blue and pink-purple hues drift through the inky black water, their translucent bodies and trailing tentacles creating an ethereal, otherworldly atmosphere. Particle effects add to the sense of vast oceanic depth.

frames.text: Dark deep ocean abyss scene with bioluminescent jellyfish. A large blue-glowing jellyfish floats on the left side, another smaller glowing form visible in the distance. Deep blue-black water with tiny particles floating like stars in the darkness.

Two bioluminescent jellyfish in the dark abyss - a blue translucent one at the top trailing bubbles and delicate tentacles, and a pink-purple one below. Rich contrast between the glowing ethereal creatures and the deep black water.

Large pink-purple bioluminescent jellyfish prominently displayed with flowing tentacles decorated with dotted patterns. A small glowing blue fish swims in the upper left. Deep dark blue water with scattered particle effects creates a magical atmosphere.
